title: Kayak Fishing & FREE Seminars – May 17
author: Quest Watersports
summary_html: Quest Watersports hosted free kayak fishing seminars on May 17, 2014.
body_html:
Join us on July 12 to try a Hobie Kayak & make a day of the festivities in Yorkville…all located at Bicentennial Riverfront Park & Marge Cline Whitewater Park:

  • FREE Hobie kayak tryouts from 9:30 to 5 – Hobie reps will join us & we’ll launch just upriver from the whitewater park (plenty of flat water).
  • Whitewater classes & competition, cardboard regatta & whitewater rodeo from 8 to 5 – more info here.
  • Live music & Yorkville’s Ribs on the River festival – all day and evening too!

Snacks, food, water/pop, dessert, ice/coolers & mixers will be provided. Feel free to bring your own “adult beverages” of choice.
